beginner.introduction: Imagine telling a friend what happened in a movie. You say: 'First this happened, then that happened.' That is STORY. Now imagine your friend asks WHY those things happened. When you answer WHY — that becomes PLOT.
beginner.coreExplanation: Story = events in time order. Plot = those same events connected by cause and effect. E.M. Forster explained: 'The king died, and then the queen died' — story. 'The king died, and then the queen died of grief' — plot. The word 'grief' is the cause.
keyPoints: Plot makes readers ask 'What happens next?'
Good novels have both story AND plot
beginner.everydayAnalogy: Story: 'I missed the bus.' Plot: 'I missed the bus because I overslept after studying late.' Plot explains WHY.
commonMistakes: Ignoring non-linear plots — they are still plots

university.introduction: Plot is the causal and temporal architecture of narrative fiction. Story (fabula) = chronological sequence. Plot (syuzhet) = artistic arrangement.
university.coreExplanation: Russian Formalists distinguished fabula vs syuzhet. Forster defined plot as causality. Genette added order, duration, frequency. Together, these frameworks allow deeper analysis.

keyTheories.name: Freytag's Pyramid
keyTheories.description: Exposition → Rising Action → Climax → Falling Action → Resolution

keyTheories.name: Fabula vs Syuzhet
keyTheories.description: Fabula = raw events. Syuzhet = artistic arrangement.

keyTheories.name: Genette's Narrative Discourse
keyTheories.limitation: Highly technical, may ignore reader response

university.comparativeAnalysis: Golding uses a linear Freytag arc in LOTF, climaxing with Simon’s death as moral catastrophe. Hamid’s Moth Smoke uses fragmented trial testimonies, disrupting causality.

exam.introduction: Plot is a high-yield exam topic. Examiners expect theory, structure, and application to texts.

distinction.introduction: Distinction analysis asks: what ideological work does plot structure perform?
distinction.criticalAnalysis: Aristotle saw plot as the soul of tragedy. Golding uses plot against itself — the adventure arc collapses into savagery. Hamid fragments plot to reflect contested truth in postcolonial Lahore.

scholarlyPerspectives.applicationToText: LOTF delays catastrophe to intensify anticipation
Moth Smoke’s trial chronotope contests causality

distinction.comparativeDistinctionAnalysis: Golding uses Freytag to chart moral descent. Hamid dismantles Freytag to reflect epistemic uncertainty. Both choices are ideological.

lastNightRevision: Write Freytag’s Pyramid with LOTF examples
